display_name: 源监督有界身份修正学生网络原型
description: 仅在源训练时用合法 L_s 标签和 U_s 高置信伪标签产生冻结地面基座的输入梯度目标，训练推理时无标签的 2% 有界 IQ 修正器。

data.version: original7/63/30 Phase1 source physical ID contract
data.representation: IQ [2,256], received IQ, frozen blind posterior and estimated backprojection; bounded correction by source trained student
data.tx_sets_ref: Only L_s fit labels enter training; U_s uses high-confidence frozen clean F pseudo labels, no U_s truth, V or test

permissions.query_use: L_s true labels only for source fit IDs, U_s clean F pseudo targets, no U_s truth, V or test
permissions.claim_scope: Source source IDs used by F and seen in other channel views, pseudo targets not independent test; bounded correction may exploit classifier

checkpoint.initialization: Random zero-initialized student, 2% global L2 IQ correction bound; fixed blind parent and frozen ground F; DURA comparison only after training
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Blind action SHA256 0ef60a205f785bda45f9936d519e925179dbbddeef2fd6cd285a83b02a284338 and source prior SHA256 5e35516d54d3e3d1d1749933861f290c1f87c8ffdb4b863d2f9819914135ceb9
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Frozen designated Phase1 source contract; previous Phase1 development results observed, no clean-blind claim
checkpoint.selection_rule: Fixed 4096 source fit IDs, three source channel views 21/22/23, final epoch3 checkpoint; fixed RX8 384 source diagnostic. No automatic Phase1 test.

metrics_plan.scientific_rule: Training F gradients and class labels only source; source clean F pseudo targets are not truth, and small IQ norm not physical fidelity.

rows.method: input-conditioned bounded IQ residual trained to amortize source label or clean-F pseudo target gradients
rows.purpose: test whether label-free input student generalizes bounded identity correction
rows.seed_notes: 4096 fit IDs disjoint from 8192 prior IDs; source fit/order seed 2026121155 and fixed RX8 source probe
rows.scenario: source clean and six simulated impaired scenes

notes: Source label metadata contains 6300 L_s labels for ID verification; only fit-ID L_s labels enter training.
U_s clean F high-confidence pseudo labels only; no U_s truth, V or test.
F input gradients computed only for source training; no gradient or label at inference.
Correction <=2% L2 is not proof of physical fidelity; report IQ and recognition outcomes.
